summary: An on/off control, in three sizes and three shapes, with an optional icon revealed on the track.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label, for the consequence of turning it on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when you are not controlling it. Pair `checked` with `onCheckedChange` instead if you are.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled switch.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shown on the track, revealed as the thumb slides past it once checked. Absent from the DOM while unchecked, not just hidden.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius, applied to the track and the thumb together. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the whole control, label included.

props.name: animated
props.description: The thumb's slide when the state changes. Turn it off for an instant jump, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
